scope: Coverage and limits from the reviewer final message. This is an attestation, not an independently exported image-view tool trace. Original scores remain in the byte-preserved locked review.
message: Saved review.json in the assigned reviewer-1 directory. Coverage is complete for all twelve outputs and all six matched pairs in the assigned order. I inspected 333 unique images: all 192 stable originals, all 36 supplemental originals, 78 selected temporal originals, 24 overview sheets, and three benchmark images. This includes every required width, available theme, and work view. Material limits are recorded in the file. No continuous video playback or live interaction was observed. Ordered samples support only their captured states; motion smoothness, natural timing, persistence, keyboard behavior, and action outcomes remain unverified. Off-screen content and complete article bodies are assessed only where actually visible.
